about:
ACS Industries Inc was founded in 1941 in Lincoln, Rhode Island. The company remains headquartered there and operates as a vertically integrated wire mesh manufacturer.

The company produces a range of critical components including pyrotechnic airbag inflator filters, coolants, cushions, automotive exhaust components, and safety components. Its manufacturing capabilities span woven metal mesh, expanded metal, knitted wire mesh, wire cloth, sintering and brazing, crimping, wire drawing, annealing, stamping, and part assembly. ACS operates over 1,000,000 square feet of manufacturing space across facilities in Rhode Island, Texas, Romania, Mexico, China, India, and Germany, supported by a state‑of‑the‑art R&D center in Rhode Island.

ACS serves automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, delivering hundreds of millions of airbag inflator filters annually. It also supplies the green energy sector with components for PEM and alkaline electrolyzers, and provides products for insulation and cleaning‑supply applications. Long‑term partnerships with major automotive manufacturers underscore its position in safety‑critical supply chains.

ACS differentiates itself as the only supplier offering all four preferred filter media — knitted wire mesh, woven wire mesh, micro expanded metal, and sintered wound‑wire. Proprietary technologies such as Variable Expanded Metal (V.E.M.) and MicroExpan metal expanding, along with a 3D knitting process for electrolyzer components, enable tight‑tolerance, low‑waste production. The company emphasizes early engineering engagement and rapid prototyping to move projects from concept to mass production.
